inlines.v: APOC'RISARY, noun [Gr. from answer, to answer.] Anciently a resident in an imperial city, in the name of a foreign church or bishop, answering to the modern nuncio. He was a proctor, in the emperor's court, to negotiate, and transact business for his constituent.
